# The exclusions of the JSON-Schema-Test-Suite (ADR-010 D5 item 7, D14
# item 4): the cases whose outcome METAIS's own rules change. Each line is
# five tab-separated fields: the file under draft2020-12, the case's
# description, the test's description or * for every test of the case,
# the outcome METAIS gives instead (a finding code NewCompiler reports, or
# valid or invalid), and the ADR-003 item that rules it.
# TestJSONSchemaTestSuite holds METAIS to that outcome, so a line records
# what METAIS does and skips nothing, and it fails on a line no test
# matches. Updating the suite re-reads these lines.
#
# ADR-003 D3 item 2: $vocabulary, and a $schema other than draft 2020-12's,
# are refused.
# ADR-003 D3 item 6: a pattern outside ADR-009 D10's profile is refused;
# \p{Letter} names a general category by a form RE2 cannot express.
# ADR-003 D4 item 1: every format of the list is asserted, by the grammar
# that item names. hostname is RFC 1123 section 2.1, which checks no
# A-label against IDNA, and uri-template's literals are RFC 6570 section
# 2.1's, which exclude the apostrophe.
# ADR-003 D4 item 2: idn-email, idn-hostname, iri, iri-reference and regex
# are refused.
# ADR-003 D5 item 3: a reference resolves only inside the package; the
# suite's remotes are never fetched.
dynamicRef.json	$ref and $dynamicAnchor are independent of order - $defs first	*	schema.ref_unresolved	ADR-003 D5 item 3
dynamicRef.json	$ref and $dynamicAnchor are independent of order - $ref first	*	schema.ref_unresolved	ADR-003 D5 item 3
dynamicRef.json	$ref to $dynamicRef finds detached $dynamicAnchor	*	schema.ref_unresolved	ADR-003 D5 item 3
dynamicRef.json	strict-tree schema, guards against misspelled properties	*	schema.ref_unresolved	ADR-003 D5 item 3
dynamicRef.json	tests for implementation dynamic anchor and reference link	*	schema.ref_unresolved	ADR-003 D5 item 3
